overview: Phase 0b sensitivity gate (GO/NO-GO for using frozen pi0 flow-matching loss as a phrase-level reward). 250 BridgeV2 val contexts x ~92 phrases each (original + 3 arms: gemini_pro=gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini_flash=gemini-3.5-flash, qwen=Qwen3.5-9B base with thinking disabled; 32 rephrases/arm, deduped) x K=16 shared (eps, tau) draws (CRN), scored on both INTACT pi0 checkpoints on 1x RTX A6000. RESULT: GO. Median z-scored split-half Spearman ~0.95 across all arms and both checkpoints (signal share ~0.98); phrase-length/loss correlation ~0 (no length hack axis); discriminability flat-high for tau>=0.3 and collapses near tau=0 (clean-action end, lerobot convention: tau=1 is noise). Rephrase-FT checkpoint shows ~25% SMALLER phrase spread than plain checkpoint (paraphrase training increased invariance, as hypothesized). Oracle: best rephrase beats original instruction in 96-98% of contexts, median 31-33% relative loss reduction — large candidate-set headroom. Qwen arm spread within ~75-100% of Gemini arms -> no larger generator model needed for now.
